description: Supply chain reports HB-900 customs delay. Avionics confirms test on original date. System must detect conflict via dependency graph.

messages.text: Bad news team - just got off the phone with TechSupply Corp. The H-Bridge Driver (HB-900) is stuck in customs. They're saying it's the same documentation issue as last time with the capacitors. Looking at a 2 week delay, so new ETA is October 25th. @channel
Reminder: The TVC Actuator Integration Test is confirmed for this Friday, October 15th at 9am in Lab 3. All prep work is complete. @sarah @mike please confirm attendance.
Who ate the last bagel from the break room? I had my name on it! 😤
Thanks for the heads up. Can we expedite customs clearance? What's the cost to air freight once it clears?
Confirmed - I'll be there Friday. Have we received the HB-900 driver yet? Want to make sure all components are on hand before we start.
